organizations.name: Hope Mission
organizations.summary: A fictional organization that equips, sends, and supports families working in education and community development.

organizations.name: Backlands Project
organizations.summary: A fictional mission network dedicated to water, health, and local leadership initiatives in Brazil.

organizations.name: Hope Nations
organizations.summary: A fictional organization that connects churches and cross-cultural teams with education and community care projects.

missionaries.shortBio: Serving families and training local leaders in Angola.
missionaries.story: The Oliveira family began their mission journey alongside a local church. Today, they work in leadership development, family care, and community initiatives created in partnership with Angolan leaders.
missionaries.currentMission: Support families, equip educators, and develop a local team that can carry the work forward.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional family walking through an open landscape

missionaries.shortBio: Community education and local development in Mozambique.
missionaries.story: João and Ana work with teachers and families to expand educational opportunities. The project grew from requests made by the community and is supported by a local team.
missionaries.currentMission: Build a community classroom and equip educators to lead after-school activities.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional missionary couple on a rural road

missionaries.shortBio: Partnerships with rural communities in the backlands of Piauí.
missionaries.story: Lucas and Mariana live in Piauí and support initiatives developed with community associations, churches, and local health workers.
missionaries.currentMission: Improve access to water, visit communities, and train local volunteers.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional couple in a Brazilian backlands landscape

missionaries.shortBio: Preventive health and support for riverside communities.
missionaries.story: Beatriz and Rafael work with local professionals on educational programs and regular visits to communities reached by river.
missionaries.currentMission: Make travel safer and strengthen preventive health work led by community health workers.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional missionary team near a river

missionaries.shortBio: Teacher training and family support in Nepal.
missionaries.story: Sarah is part of a multicultural team that serves local organizations. Her work focuses on teacher training and support for community spaces.
missionaries.currentMission: Prepare materials and support a new training cycle for local educators.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional missionary looking over a mountain region

missionaries.shortBio: Reading, culture, and youth development in Kenya.
missionaries.story: Daniel and Clara support a Kenyan organization that runs reading clubs and safe learning spaces for teenagers.
missionaries.currentMission: Set up small community libraries managed by local educators and volunteers.

portrait.alternativeText: Fictional missionary couple in a reading space

campaigns.title: A school for Nampula
campaigns.shortDescription: Help a community complete its first multipurpose classroom.
campaigns.story: The community has prepared the site and appointed a local team to oversee construction. This demo campaign brings together building materials, transportation, and initial training for educators.

campaigns.title: Walk with the Oliveira Family
campaigns.shortDescription: Monthly support for their long-term presence, training, and family care work in Angola.
campaigns.story: Monthly support sustains the family's long-term presence, travel, training materials, and a care reserve for times of transition.

cover.alternativeText: Path through green fields in Angola

campaigns.title: Support João and Ana in the field
campaigns.shortDescription: Join the family's education work with monthly support.
campaigns.story: A stable monthly base allows João and Ana to focus on their partnerships and report back consistently.

campaigns.title: Water for the backlands
campaigns.shortDescription: Drill and install a new community well.
campaigns.story: The local association selected the site and defined a shared plan for access and maintenance. The campaign covers the survey, drilling, pump, and training for the team responsible for the well.

campaigns.title: Monthly support in the backlands
campaigns.shortDescription: Monthly support for visits, training, and team care.
campaigns.story: Predictable monthly support keeps the team close to local communities and prevents the work from being interrupted between campaigns.

cover.alternativeText: Path through a Brazilian backlands landscape

campaigns.title: A boat to serve communities
campaigns.shortDescription: Safe transportation for educational work in riverside communities.
campaigns.story: The demo boat will be shared with local community workers and used on routes agreed upon with the communities they serve.

cover.alternativeText: Small boat crossing a wide river

campaigns.title: Follow Sarah in Nepal
campaigns.shortDescription: Monthly support for teacher training and community care.
campaigns.story: The monthly goal covers living costs, materials, and follow-up travel completed with local partners.

cover.alternativeText: Mountains seen from a community in Nepal

campaigns.title: Libraries that bring people together
campaigns.shortDescription: Create four small community reading spaces.
campaigns.story: Local educators will choose the books and manage the spaces. The campaign covers shelving, books, and volunteer training.

cover.alternativeText: Shelves and tables in a community reading space

updates.title: Site preparation has begun
updates.body: The local team marked the area and began preparing the site with families from the community.

media.alternativeText: Prepared site for a community classroom

updates.title: First materials confirmed
updates.body: The supplier confirmed the first delivery of materials, and the timeline was reviewed with the local committee.

updates.title: A new cycle with families
updates.body: A new series of gatherings created with neighborhood leaders began this month.

media.alternativeText: Path used by the team during community visits

updates.title: Training the local team
updates.body: Four new volunteers completed their initial training and are now supporting the gatherings.

updates.title: Planning with educators
updates.body: The team set priorities for the next quarter and assigned responsibilities.

updates.title: Soil survey completed
updates.body: The technical team completed the survey and confirmed a suitable drilling site.

media.alternativeText: Area selected for the community well

updates.title: Maintenance committee formed
updates.body: The community selected the people who will oversee construction and future maintenance.

updates.title: A week of visits
updates.body: The team visited three communities and reviewed the schedule for upcoming training sessions.

updates.title: Routes planned with local teams
updates.body: The first routes were planned with safe, dependable travel as the priority.

updates.title: Materials reviewed together
updates.body: Local educators reviewed the materials and suggested examples that better reflect family life in their communities.

media.alternativeText: Mountain landscape near the training site

updates.title: New group confirmed
updates.body: A new group of educators confirmed that they will join the next training cycle.

updates.title: The first book list
updates.body: Educators prepared an initial list balancing local literature, reference books, and reading for young people.

media.alternativeText: Books arranged on a wooden table

updates.title: Partner spaces selected
updates.body: Four community spaces were selected to host the demo libraries.
